mapper.update: UPDATE digests SET content_md=#{contentMd}, facts=#{factsJson}::jsonb, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=false
mapper.select: SELECT d.content_md FROM digests d JOIN chapters c ON c.id = d.chapter_id WHERE c.novel_id=#{novelId} AND c.chapter_no < #{beforeChapter} AND d.is_deleted=false ORDER BY c.chapter_no DESC LIMIT #{n}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO digests (chapter_id, content_md, facts) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{contentMd}, #{factsJson}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM digests WHERE chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND is_deleted=false

SELECT d.id, c.chapter_no AS "chapterNo", d.content_md AS "contentMd", d.facts::text AS facts, to_char(d.update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updateTime" FROM digests d JOIN chapters c ON c.id = d.chapter_id WHERE c.novel_id=#{novelId} AND d.is_deleted=false ORDER BY c.chapter_no
